summary: Jefferson Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the proposed offering by its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Jefferson Capital Holdings, LLC, of $100 million aggregate principal amount of 8.250% senior notes due 2030 as add-on notes under an existing indenture dated May 2, 2025, alongside $500 million of existing notes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special-situation event. The filing includes press releases and disclaimers; no change of control, restructuring, or other transformative action is involved.
